source.note: Names are the Figma component names with the icon/ prefix dropped. Branded icons carry an orange label (#c33d04) on the source sheet, which says they are specific to a product or service and not for universal use. That colour was read out of the export, not judged by eye.
source.payload_note: The markup lives in one file, not 497. A skill package is capped at 200 files and the loose SVGs put it at 610. Split in two on purpose: this manifest stays small so lint_source.py can parse it inside its 30ms budget, and the megabyte of markup sits in icons.json, which only the inliner and the teardown ever open.
